scope: Six same-instant Noah causal pairs,144 continuous manual fixed-step samples, two display-only fountain sorting examples; not all characters/full game/Pixel

visual_review.method: Original six paired PNG regions, full fountain PNGs and selected full motion crops; contact sheets of all144 native crops. Analysis crops are derivatives, not new native renders. No video playback/Pixel observation claimed.
visual_review.identity: No important new face, clothing, hue, body or tail identity damage observed in received Noah scope; unchanged formal atlas identity verified.
visual_review.motion: Left walk, stop, right reversal/walk, blink and actual Noah greeting/reaction are visible. This verifies motion exists, not real-time smoothness on Pixel.
visual_review.grounding_hold: Ground shadow is difficult to read at the normal town scale; the difference in grounded presence remains weak. Name card occupies the area immediately below the paws. No UI change made.
visual_review.depth_hold: New tonal shading and lean are visible, but face/body remain mostly frontal. In my review the difference does not yet clearly meet the user requirement of obvious dimensionality.
visual_review.gesture: Paw/greeting movement and closed-eye reaction are visible; restrained motion alone is not taken as 2.5D approval.
visual_review.existing_ui_constraint: Conversation panel overlaps the hat/ears in both Before and After; retained existing UI, not a new Noah regression.
visual_review.sorting: Actual sibling order flips correctly with declared world feet Y. These two placed examples have little direct overlap with fountain body; they do not prove full occlusion, walk route, or all wood/bench/building interactions.
visual_review.other_characters_scope: All six paired differences outside Noah projected bounds are zero. Momo is visible in this episode; not a separate visual acceptance of all other five residents.

work_this_turn: Receipt, independent integrity/pixel checks, visual review and saved records only; no runtime/capture/QA code changes, no requested re-capture or rebuild for record-only updates.
